headline: Pakistan has approved a tax-neutral bonded policy allowing Saudi companies to set up commercial oil reserves in the country, Petroleum Minister Ali Pervaiz Malik told the new Saudi Ambassador.

card.desc: Pakistan approves tax-neutral policy for Saudi commercial oil reserves.

caption:
Pakistan has approved a tax-neutral bonded policy allowing Saudi companies to set up commercial oil reserves in the country without local tax liabilities, Business Recorder reports. In talks with Petroleum Minister Ali Pervaiz Malik, the new Saudi Ambassador announced same-day processing of visa applications for Pakistani citizens at the embassy in Islamabad.
